project_type: Python microservices payment-decisioning POC (ACIP). uv workspace monorepo: shared lib libs/acip-common, isolated ML project ml/, demo scripts scripts/, Docker Compose under deploy/. Phase 2 added 7 FastAPI core-path services under services/*; Phase 3 adds the 6 agents + graph-projector (the 8 dirs currently empty / in workspace exclude) plus a new shared agent-scaffolding lib libs/acip-agent-common.
build_system: uv 0.5.4 workspace. Root pyproject.toml [tool.uv.workspace] members = ['libs/*','services/*'] with an exclude list of the still-empty Phase-3 dirs. QUIRK (from Phase 2, repeat for every new member): to make a service a real member you MUST (1) remove its dir from [tool.uv.workspace].exclude, (2) add it to [tool.uv.sources] as { workspace = true }, AND (3) add it to [dependency-groups].dev — otherwise `uv run pytest services`/mypy cannot import its deps. Each service pyproject declares acip-common = { workspace = true } (agents also acip-agent-common = { workspace = true }). Docker images build with repo ROOT as context: `docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml build`.
test_framework: pytest 8.3.4 (pinned in root dev group). Tests per package under tests/test_*.py. External deps (Kafka, Neo4j, Postgres, Redis, httpx to ml-scoring/llm-gateway) are mocked/injected — no live infra needed for unit tests.
test_command: uv run pytest libs/acip-common libs/acip-agent-common services   (per package: uv run pytest services/<name>)
verification_instructions: Full gate from repo root: 1) uv sync; 2) uv run ruff check . ; 3) uv run black --check . ; 4) uv run mypy libs services ; 5) uv run pytest libs/acip-common libs/acip-agent-common services ; 6) docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config. Live demo (Docker up): make up && make seed && make demo and confirm the five scenarios return clean_shopper->APPROVE, ring_member->DECLINE(fraud), high_value_midrisk->CHALLENGE, sanctioned_geo->DECLINE(policy), unhealthy_preferred_route->APPROVE on alternate route, with NO cloud creds (llm-gateway mock; agent degraded=true templated rationale acceptable). If Docker is unavailable, substitute an in-process integration test driving the six agent scorers + decision-engine aggregate per scenario and state that the live smoke was not run. Clean up temp files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: ml/models/ holds trained artifacts (gitignored): risk-xgb-<date>.json, fraud-lgbm-<date>.txt, model_card.json (resolve via model_card.json, never hardcode the 2026 date). Produce with: make train. The risk/fraud agents call ml-scoring-service over HTTP; agents DO NOT load models or mount ml/models. scripts/seed.py seeds Neo4j + Postgres demo scenarios; run with make seed before the live demo so agents produce the expected verdicts.
environment_constraints: Stay on branch feat/phase1-foundation; do NOT branch/reset/rebase/amend/force-push. Do NOT modify anything under docs/. Stack MUST run with NO cloud creds (llm-gateway degrades to mock; agents use a templated rationale with degraded=true so the decision never blocks on the LLM). Only checkout-api publishes a host port (8080:8000); all other services internal on acip-net container port 8000. Pin all new deps to exact versions; secrets via env only. uv 0.5.4 and docker 27.3.1 confirmed available.
contribution_requirements: Match existing code style: `from __future__ import annotations`, full docstrings citing doc sections (e.g. 'docs/02 §2.2'), mypy strict compliance, ruff rules E/F/I/UP/B/W, black + ruff line-length 100. Reuse acip-common contracts (schemas, config, features, kafka, logging, topics) — import, never redefine. New shared agent scaffolding goes in a NEW lib libs/acip-agent-common (import acip_agent_common), NOT in acip-common. New config keys and the runtime bootstrap helper ARE additive to acip-common (no new dependency). Keep all Phase 1/2 files intact except the explicit edits named in the FEATs (bootstrap call in orchestrator persistence, 404-on-missing-table in checkout-api reads, async idempotency in checkout-api main, new config keys, compose+Makefile+demo wiring, workspace wiring).
key_patterns: acip-common is the single source of contracts. Kafka wire format = EventEnvelope JSON keyed by transaction_id (acip_common.kafka.EventProducer/EventConsumer, manual commit AFTER publish). Topics via acip_common.topics: orchestrator fan_out publishes TxnEvaluateRequestedPayload (EventType.TXN_EVALUATE_REQUESTED) to TXN_EVALUATE; agents publish AgentVerdictProducedPayload (EventType.AGENT_VERDICT_PRODUCED) to AGENT_VERDICTS keyed by transaction_id; orchestrator collect_verdicts filters by transaction_id + AGENT_VERDICT_PRODUCED and waits for all six AgentName. decision-engine aggregate() keys verdicts by AgentName.value (risk,fraud,routing,policy,merchant,checkout_personalization) and already honors: policy DECLINE + fraud.score>=fraud_block_threshold as hard vetoes; merchant force_challenge evidence or CHALLENGE hint upgrades APPROVE->CHALLENGE; personalization.rationale is the recommended_method; routes ranked by success_rate. Agents emit Verdicts shaped to drive those existing branches. Thresholds/weights from Settings, never hardcoded. Every service has GET /healthz + GET /readyz. Postgres read-model table shapes are defined in scripts/seed.py and must match exactly (transactions/decisions/agent_verdicts/event_journal).
relevant_files: libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/schemas.py (Verdict, Evidence, AgentName, SharedRepresentation, AgentVerdictProducedPayload, TxnEvaluateRequestedPayload, DecisionRenderedPayload, TxnTerminalPayload, EventEnvelope, EventType, CandidateRoute, MethodHistoryEntry, TxnCreatedPayload - REUSE)
